comments.body: Any opinions on how to test this? I currently have roughly the same NixOS module running in production as I already modified the `mautrix-telegram` module, and now ported it to NixOS, since it finally officially got released.

1. I think we should keep the python bridge around for a while, the new bridge removes the old style relaybot, making the migration not so frictionless
2. we've always wanted a generic nixos module that works for all of the go bridges, this can be the chance pursuing that.
Idea: make it a modular service? https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/c8f5b96f5a6222a573cb0c61b74d47ffd868d7b6/nixos/doc/manual/development/modular-services.md
That might be a good idea. All bridges share the same config now, except for the `network` section and of course defaults like the bot name.

> That might be a good idea. All bridges share the same config now, except for the `network` section and of course defaults like the bot name.

We don't even need to provide that default in the module, the go code handles merging user config with the default automatically it seems.

Yeah, I implied that. I am not at all comfortable with modular services though, so this might not be a very good idea for me to pursue yet. As for keeping the Python bridge around: I am not sure if that is a good idea, since it is not maintained anymore since around september last year, and won't be maintained anymore if I'm correct.

> As for keeping the Python bridge around: I am not sure if that is a good idea, since it is not maintained anymore since around september last year, and won't be maintained anymore if I'm correct.

Yes, it would never see any updates. But the migration is a non-trivial effort, I don't want to force the users to update NOW, or stuck on an outdated version of nixpkgs.

Alright. Should I for now just add a new `mautrix-telegram-go` module then? And then a `mautrix-telegram-go` package that goes with it? Then we can work on migrating all go bridges to a unified modular service or module separately.
I believe there were some talks about a generic module before, search github issues/PRs first maybe?
There is #338249 but nothing concrete as far as I can see at a glance.
Ok I got a draft for a module that works for both the python and go version of the bridge, commit by commit: https://github.com/NickCao/nixpkgs/commits/mautrix-telegram-go-module/
I'm sorry for letting this become stale, I'll incorporate the feedback :)

Will test this all later (as I do not currently have a spare home server to do so, will need some tests as well), but I incorporated everyone's feedback, meaning I'd like some early feedback on the course I am taking. I am not sure if going with a mautrix-telegram**-go** package is the way to go, but it got suggested by @NickCao so I am going with this. As said before, pretty rough quick refactor, but pushed anyway since I am not sure if this is desirable.
may use a rebase over merge conflicts

Changelog: https://github.com/mautrix/telegram/releases/tag/v0.2604.0
Release announcement: https://mau.fi/blog/2026-04-mautrix-release/

- **mautrix-telegram: 0.15.3 -> 0.2604.0**
- **mautrix-telegram: add bartoostveen to meta.maintainers**
- **nixos/mautrix-telegram: migrate to bridgev2**
- **nixos/mautrix-telegram: document removal of Python-based bridge**

Not sure if I did the right thing, as this is a large breaking change. It seems like there is not a good migration path though, so this might be the only way.
The docs are based on Mautrix-Whatsapp docs. ~~Still marked as WIP since I want to get this tested properly first.~~

Package tests still do not pass in the nix container, so `doCheck` is still set to `false`.
